errors.evidence: The chart shows that the value drops to a local minimum below -3 €/MWh in November 2024. In December, the value recovers and fluctuates mostly between -3 €/MWh and 0 €/MWh, so describing its values as 'around -3 €/MWh' is inaccurate and misses the recovery trend.

errors.evidence: In January 2025, the line shows a sharp drop from approximately -2 €/MWh to a minimum of about -6 €/MWh. It does not rise as stated in the description.

errors.text_span: fällt dann weiter ab und erreicht im Februar 2025 einen Tiefpunkt von etwa -6 €/MWh
